summary: Iteration 21 - P2 Backlog Features Testing. All 4 features implemented and working: (1) Token blacklist for secure logout + password reset flow, (2) Strategy sharing via public links, (3) Watchlist for screener results, (4) Strategy leaderboard. Backend: 15/18 tests passed (3 skipped due to rate limits/duplicates). Frontend: All pages load correctly with proper data-testids.

minor.issue: PasswordResetResponse model was missing reset_token field - FIXED by adding Optional[str] field

critical_code_review_comments: Token blacklist uses MongoDB collection with TTL index for auto-cleanup - correctly implemented
Password reset tokens use TTL (1 hour) - correctly implemented
Forgot-password returns reset_token directly in response (no email service) - as designed
Sharing system stores strategy snapshot at share-time - correctly implemented
Watchlist has 20-item limit per user and prevents duplicates - correctly implemented
Leaderboard endpoint sorts templates by clone_count descending - correctly implemented
All frontend pages have proper data-testids for testing
